resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list gives 1,507 for the entry; Wikipedia gives the summit as 1,322 feet (403 m). The story reports both and does not choose between them.

notes_for_editor: Only the tnlandforms list places a tower here; its name is the compiler's label, since the page says names for towers 73 and above were made up. The list's author is not named on the page, so the story does not credit one. Searches found no build, staffing, fire or removal record. Could not read the GFC history page (timeout), the 2006 Savannah Now article linked from the list (403), or the NHLR Georgia state page (404). Cached NHLR and FFLOS pages do not name this site. Wikipedia coordinates (34.2298, -85.2447) sit about 1 km from the list point (34.23316, -85.23444); not reported. Wikipedia's list of fire lookout towers names only two Georgia towers, neither here.
